## Lists

## Math

Scaled delimiters $\bigl(a + b\bigr)^2$ and a negative kern
$\Phi\!\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)$ in running text, and on display:

$$
P = \Phi\!\left(\frac{\mu}{\sigma}\right) + \bigl(1 - \Phi(z)\bigr)
$$
